scope: Selected shared PGC/PGC-PYMES accounts, not a complete chart or sector adaptation.

accounts.title: Aplicaciones informáticas
accounts.description: Acquired capitalizable software rights with enduring use; not recurring SaaS subscriptions. Capitalization policy must be reviewed.

accounts.title: Maquinaria
accounts.description: Production machinery held for continuing business use, not inventory for resale.

accounts.title: Mobiliario
accounts.description: Office furniture acquired for enduring use; review capitalization policy.

accounts.title: Equipos para procesos de información
accounts.description: Computers and information-processing equipment acquired for enduring internal use; not resale inventory.

accounts.title: Elementos de transporte
accounts.description: Vehicles acquired as business fixed assets, not rentals or resale inventory. Does not establish tax deductibility.

accounts.title: Compras de mercaderías
accounts.description: Goods purchased for resale without transformation; not fixed assets or raw materials.

accounts.title: Compras de materias primas
accounts.description: Raw materials purchased for transformation in production.

accounts.title: Compras de otros aprovisionamientos
accounts.description: Other production supplies or consumables, not office services or merchandise for resale.

accounts.title: Trabajos realizados por otras empresas
accounts.description: Subcontracted production work forming part of the entity's own production process; distinguish independent professional advisory services 623.

accounts.title: Arrendamientos y cánones
accounts.description: Operating rental of premises, equipment or rights/royalties. Finance leases require specialist review.

accounts.title: Reparaciones y conservación
accounts.description: Maintenance or repairs restoring condition; improvements creating enduring benefits need asset review.

accounts.title: Servicios de profesionales independientes
accounts.description: Independent legal, tax, accounting, consultancy, architect or similar professional fees.

accounts.title: Transportes
accounts.description: Third-party freight/transport expenses not included in asset or inventory acquisition cost.

accounts.title: Primas de seguros
accounts.description: Insurance premiums; do not infer VAT from the account.

accounts.title: Servicios bancarios y similares
accounts.description: Bank service fees and commissions, not interest on debt (662).

accounts.title: Publicidad, propaganda y relaciones públicas
accounts.description: Advertising campaigns, promotion and public-relations services.

accounts.title: Suministros
accounts.description: Electricity, gas, water and other non-storable supplies.

accounts.title: Otros servicios
accounts.description: Other external services not covered by 621-628; recurring SaaS access, telecom or office services. Do not use when the transaction is unclear.

accounts.title: Otros tributos
accounts.description: Business taxes other than income tax, as applicable; excludes penalties, collected VAT and amounts forming asset cost.

accounts.title: Sueldos y salarios
accounts.description: Gross wages and salary expense evidenced as a single component; not the whole multi-component payroll journal.

accounts.title: Seguridad Social a cargo de la empresa
accounts.description: Employer social-security cost separately identified; not employee withholding or a self-employed person's RETA payment by assumption.

accounts.title: Otros gastos sociales
accounts.description: Other employer welfare/social expenditure explicitly documented, not ordinary wages or employer contributions.

accounts.title: Intereses de deudas
accounts.description: Interest expense on borrowings, not loan principal or bank service commissions.

accounts.title: Otros gastos financieros
accounts.description: Other clearly identified financing expenses not allocated to another specific financial expense account.

accounts.title: Ventas de mercaderías
accounts.description: Revenue from sale of goods purchased for resale without transformation.

accounts.title: Ventas de productos terminados
accounts.description: Revenue from sale of finished goods manufactured by the entity.

accounts.title: Prestaciones de servicios
accounts.description: Revenue from services constituting the entity's ordinary activity; includes professional fees and core rental activity where appropriate.

accounts.title: Ingresos por arrendamientos
accounts.description: Ancillary rental income outside the entity's ordinary activity; ordinary rental business may use 705.

accounts.title: Ingresos por servicios diversos
accounts.description: Ancillary service income outside ordinary activity, not main service revenue 705.

accounts.title: Proveedores
accounts.description: Trade payables to merchandise and other inventory suppliers; reference only, never inferred as a complete entry.

accounts.title: Acreedores por prestaciones de servicios
accounts.description: Payables to service providers; reference only.

accounts.title: Clientes
accounts.description: Trade receivables from customers; reference only.

accounts.title: Remuneraciones pendientes de pago
accounts.description: Wages payable; reference only.

accounts.title: Hacienda Pública, IVA soportado
accounts.description: Input VAT; amount and deductibility require explicit independent validation.

accounts.title: Hacienda Pública, acreedora por IVA
accounts.description: VAT payable to tax authority; reference only.

accounts.title: Hacienda Pública, acreedora por retenciones practicadas
accounts.description: Withholdings payable; reference only.

accounts.title: Organismos de la Seguridad Social, acreedores
accounts.description: Social-security contributions payable; reference only.

accounts.title: Hacienda Pública, IVA repercutido
accounts.description: Output VAT; rate, location and liability cannot be inferred from account identity alone.

accounts.title: Caja, euros
accounts.description: Euro cash balance; reference only.

accounts.title: Bancos e instituciones de crédito c/c vista, euros
accounts.description: Euro current bank account balance; reference only.
